tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Commodity Brokerage Token
description: Stock Brokers Ltd provides retail brokerage access to warehouse receipt tokens from Morocco's certified storage facilities. regulatoryFramework: Morocco Financial Markets Act; Morocco Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Service Contract Investment Token
description: Through Stock Brokers Ltd, retail investors access pools of verified service contracts from Morocco's informal sector. By investing in a bundle of 1,000 plumber, electrician and caterer contracts, an ordinary saver earns returns while funding livelihood improvement for service workers. Minimum investment is one currency unit.
regulatoryFramework: Morocco Financial Markets Act; Morocco Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Infrastructure PPP Brokerage Token
description: Stock Brokers Ltd brings government PPP infrastructure projects to retail investors in Morocco. Each project creates hundreds of local construction and maintenance jobs.
regulatoryFramework: Morocco Financial Markets Act; Morocco Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

description: Stock Brokers Ltd makes property investment available to every Morocco citizen through fractional real estate tokens. Returns from rental income and property appreciation are distributed quarterly to all holders.

description: Through Stock Brokers Ltd, impact investors in Morocco can directly invest in verified labor tokens from informal sector workers. Each investment finances a worker's daily operating expenses (market stall rent, transport, tools) and the investor earns a micro-return. Creates a direct connection between savers and workers — everyone becomes financially included.
regulatoryFramework: Morocco Financial Markets Act; Morocco Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Civic Project Milestone Token

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Crop Season Investment Token

Each token represents a share of a diversified portfolio of seasonal crop loans to verified smallholder farmers. Harvest repayments generate investor returns. Connecting urban capital to rural food production reduces both food insecurity and rural unemployment.
regulatoryFramework: Morocco Financial Markets Act; Morocco Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd High-Street SME Token

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Community Wealth ETF Token

regulatoryFramework: Morocco Financial Markets Act; Morocco Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Stock Brokers Ltd Mobile Equity Token
description: Stock Brokers Ltd enables any mobile phone user in Morocco to buy fractional shares in listed companies. Starting from the cost of a text message, every citizen becomes a shareholder. regulatoryFramework: Morocco Financial Markets Act; Morocco Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

description: Through Stock Brokers Ltd, verified smallholder farmer output in Morocco becomes a retail investable asset.
